description: This file defines React components related to the Speedboard feature, which visualizes test reporting data such as shards, slowest tests, and other metrics in a web UI. It includes components like Speedboard, SlowestTests, and Shards, and imports several project-specific modules.

methods.name: Speedboard
methods.description: Main component rendering the speedboard report with shards and slowest tests.

methods.name: SlowestTests
methods.description: Component displaying the list of the slowest test cases with a load more button.

methods.name: Shards
methods.description: Component visualizing shard durations, highlighting issues with shard differentiation, and offering shard weight rebalancing commands.
